description: Plan, but do not execute, application of a frozen H3 routine-package update set.

action.summary: Apply only the exact frozen routine-package update set

allowed.name: updatePlanDigest
allowed.description: SHA-256 digest of the separately reviewed frozen update plan.

checks: Execution remains disabled for this runbook version
Frozen plan digest resolves to the exact reviewed package set
Backup freshness and restore evidence would be verified
Disk capacity, service health, expected interruption, and reboot requirement would be recorded
Kernel, security-policy, Docker Engine, database, and PACS changes are rejected
Dry-run result states that no package changed
Future execution would compare installed versions with the frozen plan
Future execution would verify allowlisted services and reboot state
Future execution would record a durable receipt

rollback.note: Routine package rollback is not assumed; the frozen plan must document recovery per package before future execution.
